input:
{"command": "cat > self-review.md <<'EOF'
In this repository (co), I authored about 25% of commits (75 of 299, counting my three git identities), second to the original author, TJ Holowaychuk, at 145. By `git blame`, I currently own about 52% of surviving lines in `index.js`, `Readme.md` and `test/` (599 of 1,162). That is roughly 52% of `index.js`, 60% of the Readme and most of the tests, including the recursion, objects, arrays and context tests. TJ wrote the original design and a large share of the core, and about 20 other contributors added smaller fixes. Line counts measure surviving text, not impact, and I did not build this library from scratch.
EOF
wc -w self-review.md"}
